Goutte-d'Or (18e arr.) — Paris, France

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

One of Paris's most heavily documented problem quartiers in the national press: Barbès and Château Rouge have long-running, repeatedly reported open-air dealing of cigarettes, drugs and counterfeit goods, and residents describe having to navigate around trafficking right outside their homes (Europe1, Dec 2025/updated Feb 2026). Daytime street life and markets are intense but generally manageable with normal caution; after dark the documented dealing and occasional violent incidents make this a genuinely higher-risk quartier at night. Sources checked: Europe1, 9 Dec 2025 (updated 9 Feb 2026).
